title: AI, Deepfakes and Copyright
grammar: Hedging a Forecast: feltehetőleg, minden bizonnyal
goal: I can describe the questions that deepfakes and data scraping raise (*mélyhamisítás, adatkaparás, szerzői jogi oltalom*).
I can hedge a claim about deepfakes with *feltehetőleg* and *minden bizonnyal* and say whose view it is.
I can report that authors, researchers and jurists see the copyright question differently.
